title: chore: log in and out through SAML without Meteor's accounts runtime

target.summary: logoutFromSamlIdp only catches errors from the sdk.call invocation, leaving exceptions during SDK client import or redirect creation unhandled. When SAML single logout fails to start, the unhandled rejection prevents UserProvider from falling back to local logout, leaving the user logged in.
